Spacious and versatile accommodation, including four bedrooms, three reception rooms and a farmhouse kitchen, the property also benefits from a large paddock, stable and useful outbuildings. description:
This is the kind of property that rarely comes to the market, combining generous family living space with an idyllic rural setting and over five acres of land.

A superb detached family home set in an outstanding countryside location, offering spacious and versatile accommodation that has been thoughtfully updated and extended by the current owners to an exceptionally high standard.

The well-presented accommodation includes three generous reception rooms, providing flexible living and entertaining space, together with four well-proportioned bedrooms. The impressive principal bedroom benefits from its own en-suite bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a stylish family bathroom.

At the heart of the home is a spacious farmhouse-style kitchen, complete with an electric Aga, creating a warm and welcoming space for everyday family life.

Externally, the property extends to approximately 5.29 acres, including a 4.84-acre paddock, making it ideal for equestrian use, smallholding interests, or those simply seeking space and privacy. A range of useful outbuildings, yard space and a stable provide excellent additional storage and potential for a variety of uses.

Conveniently positioned for easy access to Brampton, Carlisle and Longtown, the property combines the tranquillity of country living with excellent day-to-day accessibility. The surrounding area is renowned for its attractive rolling countryside, network of quiet lanes and bridleways, making it ideal for walking, cycling and equestrian pursuits. Despite its peaceful rural setting, a wide range of amenities, schooling, independent shops and transport links are all within easy reach, offering the perfect balance between country living and modern convenience.

Offering a wonderful combination of character, comfort and practicality in a sought-after rural setting, this exceptional home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Cumbrian countryside living.

Directions Head North out of Carlisle, take Georgian Way / A595 heading north toward the River Eden, onto the A7. Follow the A7 (Scotland Road), at the M6 / A9212 roundabout (Junction 44), take the exit to remain on the A7 heading north towards Longtown. Continue toward Westlinton & Longtown, stay on the A7 for roughly 6 miles, passing through Westlinton. Continue past The Hidden River Cafe, at the junction turn left, the property is on the right.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Drainage is to a septic tank. Any alterations required to meet current regulations are to be the responsibility of the purchaser.

Please note no formal investigation has been carried out as to the operation of the sewerage system and septic tanks, these may not meet the current General Binding Rules 2020 and the property is being sold on this basis. All parties must ensure that their lenders are aware of this before submitting an offer.
